<!-- pr-reviewer: ec7456253249d6b3c07a7b239d79896e48bf2c65 -->
Conflicts with current main. The local checks passed against the earlier main.

The safety review found no code defect in the PR changes. Both checks use the same pivot/offset predicate. The index-swing check blocks posting when the standing-steel check skips the new verdict. The zero-vector controls still pass.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse_posed.rs:13`: current main conflicts with the module comment. At merge time, merge main into this branch. Keep the #3127 refusal note and the references to decisions #3084 and #3100. Run the required gates again. Do not flag this draft ready while it conflicts.

Main changed during the review. The tests below used a clean local trial merge with `c2423f1703f706bb3a6a9e98bd206fd1b96b5bd0`. A final merge attempt against `acc01cd228bfc26ee394e25157dd7a2ba6ab1852` found the conflict above. I did not resolve it. The current main has the same AGENTS.md as the tested main.

**Local build and tests**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 9 steps passed; 348 tests passed; no failures.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 199 steps passed in 23.9 minutes. This review ran every reached app lane. Four known-failure checks failed as expected and passed their marker checks.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps passed. Both light tests passed.
- No GitHub runner was used.

| Quick suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| `lib` | 296 | 0 |
| `first_traverse_posed` | 5 | 0 |
| `index_swing` | 13 | 0 |
| `index_swing_horizontal` | 13 | 0 |
| `index_swing_offset_line` | 3 | 0 |
| `rotary_subplate` | 7 | 0 |
| `rotary_subplate_standing` | 5 | 0 |
| `setup_mount_trace` | 6 | 0 |

**Extra suites run**

The mutation rerun included the full `first_traverse_posed` and `index_swing_offset_line` suites. Both passed after source restoration. The required light lane also passed. The PR changes no fixture, golden, or importer path. The extra fixture and importer suite rules do not apply.

**Safety mutations**

I repeated the author's source rollback locally. I restored both changed source files from the tested upstream main, then ran the PR tests.

| Case | Pre-fix source | Reviewed source |
|---|---|---|
| Posed traverse with pivot | Failed: `no refusal: Ok []` | Passed |
| Index swing with pivot | Failed: 0 refusal lines; expected 1 | Passed |
| Index swing with offset | Failed: 0 refusal lines; expected 1 | Passed |
| Both zero-vector controls | Passed | Passed |

I restored the reviewed source after the mutation run. All eight tests then passed. The worktree was clean before the final merge attempt.

No goldens moved. No UI changed, so before/after screenshots are not required. The PR body states that the two-rotary offset branch and the vertical-rotary exception have no dedicated tests.
